purpose: Detect sensitive resources (confidential files, admin/metrics endpoints, key stores) reachable without authentication.
when_to_use: After a baseline check, to surface broken access control / sensitive data exposure on an authorized target. Safe-active (risk 2): sends several controlled GETs but changes no state.
detection_approach: Request a curated list of sensitive paths (probe list is config in src/skills/web/exposed_sensitive_paths.json) and report those returning 200, matching an expected confidential marker where one is given. Detection is dynamic from live responses, never hardcoded findings.
